根据角色描述保持滤镜风格

Cinematic widescreen portrait of a realistic East Asian black-market neural implant doctor in his late forties, retro Soviet sci-fi. Stocky build, weathered rectangular face, receding coarse hair, tired skin. A dark medical mask covers his nose and mouth; round copper-rimmed aviator goggles with smoked glass dominate his face. He wears the clinic uniform: a graphite high-collar wrap coat, deep oxblood shoulder yoke and forearm panels, offset copper clasps, reinforced square pockets, faded ivory rubber apron and black surgical gloves. The coat is carefully maintained with resewn seams and chemical discoloration. A circular optical loupe and sterilized tools hang from his belt. He stands inside a cramped working implant clinic among repaired cream consoles, braided cables and steel trays. Amber surgical light meets cool monitor glow, high-contrast Paprika-like dream logic, Next-Gen PBR textures on skin, smoked glass, metal, rubber and worn fabric, 35mm full-frame cinema lens, photo-realism
